fusions.name: Flushing Snap
fusions.desc: A darting snap that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of health the target still has (max 30%).

fusions.name: Frozen in the Open
fusions.desc: A snarl through a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: White-Tail Bolt
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Flight Response
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
